title: Maybe the moral doesn't lie with the mouse and the frog but to the raven keen enough to welcome two meals strung together #poetryport
summary: Maybe the moral doesn't lie with the mouse and the frog but to the raven keen enough to welcome two meals strung together #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Maybe the moral
doesn't lie with the
mouse and the frog
but to the raven
keen enough
to welcome two
meals strung together
#poetryport
